messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Does Stan have a memory limit?
parts:
On Monday, April 3, 2017 at 2:25:11 AM UTC-4, Jingjing Chen wrote:
I am not sure if it sounds dumb but is there such a memory limit for Stan? Say if I have a really large project and I request 500GB of memory,  is that gonna be a problem for STAN?
There is no memory limit, but getting a model like that to run in a reasonable amount of time requires considerable skill and quite possibly custom gradients in some places.
